title: `lean_nat_mod` returned a wrong value at the small/big-nat boundary
summary: On 64-bit systems, `lean_nat_mod` truncated when the divisor was between 2^32 and 2^64: `2^65 % (2^33+1)` returned 1 instead of 2^32+1. Root cause was the scalar/mpz line drawn at 32-bit width in `get_unsigned_int`. A route to a proof of False via kernel reduction. Pre-stable; reported and fixed the same day in nightly-2022-08-04. Would be caught by lean4lean and nanoda.
